description: Provides four named patch points inside a STRIP, so cables to the rest of the patch stay connected while different strips are loaded.

inputs.text: Whatever is patched here passes straight to the output of the same number on this module; polyphonic.

outputs.text: Carries what is patched into the input of the same number on this module; polyphonic.

notes: the text identifier is typed into the display; STRIP uses it to re-attach the cables from outside the strip when a strip carrying a STRIP-BAY with the same identifier is loaded in its place.
the module passes signals through wherever it is; the identifier matters only when a STRIP loads or replaces the row it stands in.
